rule: Missing or malformed actual data is unverified/failed; no successful result follows from a static schema or default stand.

native_physics_step.t: Gazebo actual native timestamp with explicit contract state_time_offset_s: Teacher PreUpdate=-.005; CHAMP PostUpdate=0. Never assume phases equal.
native_physics_step.contact_pairs: actual collisions/point count/XYZ/normal/depth and raw wrench; no inferred force substitution

pid_required_fields.control_pose_stamp_ns: exact original SLAM stamp integer, no float reconstruction
pid_required_fields.route: actual checked SCANroute or archived float64hash reference
pid_required_fields.command: afterouterPID slew; executionconsumer owns final TTLslew
pid_required_fields.source: SLAM/SCAN only, exact source frames/stamps retained
pid_required_fields.actual_pid_world_direction: Worlddirection of theactual after-slew output; nativeguardrows explicitlycarrypid_sequence and originalPIDcomputeclock/controlheader

runtime.sources: perrun actual snapshotSHA + pre-run frozen sourceSHA; runtimecached module must matchactualloadedcopy

region_receipt: region_arrivals in navigation_status: goal_id,start_stamp_ns,stamp_ns,protected=false,control_region_inside=true; exact rawSLAMposes must independently satisfy .17/.10/.6/.2gap.
parking: Final arrival receipt first successful measured deadline +3s fixed following5s; not runtime model-position latch or late selectedstop.
